request.style: English, female vocal, ethereal, piano, strings, soft drums, atmospheric synth, hopeful, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The wind passes over it and is gone
Its place knows it no more now
But steadfast love rests from everlasting
On those who fear the name
His righteousness abides on children's children
Those who keep the covenant
Remembering to obey his precepts
With faithfulness and devotion

[Chorus]
Bless the Lord you mighty angels
Do his word and obey his voice
Bless the Lord all his hosts
Servants who do his will
Bless the Lord all his works
In every place of his dominion
Bless the Lord my soul

[Verse]
He has established his throne in the heavens
His kingdom rules over all things
The Lord is high and exalted
His glory fills the world
From the depths to the highest sky
His dominion stands firm
His word is the voice of power
Guiding every step we take

[Chorus]
Bless the Lord you mighty angels
Do his word and obey his voice
Bless the Lord all his hosts
Servants who do his will
Bless the Lord all his works
In every place of his dominion
Bless the Lord my soul

[Bridge]
His love endures forever
For those who fear him
His righteousness is sure
For their children's children
Keep his covenant true
Remember his precepts
His kingdom never fades
His throne is in the heavens

[Chorus]
Bless the Lord you mighty angels
Do his word and obey his voice
Bless the Lord all his hosts
Servants who do his will
Bless the Lord all his works
In every place of his dominion
Bless the Lord my soul

[Outro]
Bless the Lord my soul
Bless the Lord my soul
